article.content: Defensive lineman had altercation with JC Latham Titans do not confirm or deny reports around firearm Jordan Elliott, the defensive lineman released Tuesday by the Tennessee Titans, reportedly ⁠went to his car to retrieve a gun after an altercation in practice last ⁠Thursday. Ordered to leave ⁠the ​field after a scuffle with right tackle JC Latham, Elliott took off his ⁠pads, left the facility and went to the players’ lot where security cameras captured the ⁠scene, according to multiple reports from A to Z Sports ​and KPRC2.
